verdict.rationale: Kintsugi documents dozens of prebuilt connectors for shopping carts, billing systems, and accounting platforms with a one-time authorize-and-sync flow, plus a 'Data Sources' connect flow, REST API, and official SDKs in five languages for custom integrations. However, the evidence pack never names specific maintained integrations (e.g. Stripe, Shopify, specific billing/payment processors) or confirms which platforms are actually first-party vs third-party, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404s, weakening confidence in build-your-own routes. Missing for 10: named/specific commerce and payment-processor integrations, independent confirmation of integration maintenance/reliability, working OpenAPI spec discovery.
